description: Reviews agentsocks commands that edit agent configuration and hooks, message other agent sessions, bind a driver, send message text to a remote classifier, start or expose the gateway, issue gateway tokens and access, link another machine, or add a paid API peer. Read-only commands such as list, status, stats, doctor, whoami, channels, tasks and top are not matched. Based on agentsocks 0.4.0.
name: agentsocks command protection
saferAlternatives: Run agentsocks doctor, status and gateway status to inspect the install before changing it.
Use --dry-run with install and uninstall to preview the changes.
Set AGENTSOCKS_OFF=1 or touch ~/.config/agentsocks/off to stop sends, classifier calls, wakes and the gateway without uninstalling.
